ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the figure there is a node labeled 2 V, connected through a resistor labeled 2 kΩ to the "+" non-inverting input terminal at the lower left of the operational amplifier; between the resistor and the "+" input terminal there is a current arrow I, with the direction pointing toward the op-amp input terminal. The output terminal on the right side of the op-amp is fed back through the upper resistor R to the "-" input terminal at the upper left. Reasoning: I is the current entering the non-inverting input terminal of an ideal operational amplifier. The input impedance of an ideal operational amplifier is infinite, so the input terminal does not absorb current, therefore the current entering the input terminal through this 2 kΩ branch is 0.

raw_record.question_text: In the circuit shown in the figure, what is the current \(I\)?

method.method_draft: Identify I as the current entering the op-amp non-inverting input through the 2 kΩ resistor. Since the op-amp is ideal, no current can enter the input terminal. Therefore the current in that series branch must be I = 0.

method.answer_match_reason: The predicted answer is exactly 0, matching the standard answer.

answer_match_part_results.reason: Both give the same current value.

method.method_draft: Replace the non-inverting op-amp input by an open circuit. Then the 2 kΩ resistor is connected to an open terminal, so no closed path exists for current from the 2 V source. Hence the voltage drop across the 2 kΩ resistor is 0 and I = V/R = 0/2 kΩ = 0.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中左侧有一个标为 2 V 的电压源端，经一个标为 2 kΩ 的电阻连接到运算放大器左下侧的非反相输入端“+”；电流 I 的箭头标在该 2 kΩ 电阻后、指向运放“+”输入端。运放左上侧为反相输入端“-”，上方有一个电阻 R 从右侧输出节点反馈到反相输入端。推理：按指定方法，把理想运算放大器的非反相输入端视为开路。这样 2 V 源通过 2 kΩ 电阻只连接到一个开路端，没有形成闭合电流路径。因此 2 kΩ 电阻中无电流，电阻上的电压降为 0，故 I = 0/2 kΩ = 0。
method.answer_match_reason: The predicted answer is exactly the same as the standard answer: the current I is 0.
